name: dsh-codebase-memory
description: DSH host bundle: index the session workspace with codebase-memory-mcp, expose it through @njuptlzf/mcp-adapter (one ~250-token MCP proxy tool instead of 17 tool schemas), and add trigger layers — code_find/code_callers wrappers, optional grep/glob intercept, conditional runtime context, write-after staleness tracking — so symbol lookups reach the code graph without depending on how the question was phrased, with cumulative-across-restart intercept/replace counters shown as read-only cards on the settings page over a volatile channel, with six hot-editable fields (mode/tools/budget/hints/tracking/telemetry) laid out by layer with per-field reset and a read-only retrieval-layer status line, plus an out-of-session engine warm-up so the first query never pays cold-start cost. Two complementary retrieval layers: structure (codebase-memory graph) + optional semantic (zvec-grep) — the semantic layer has a settings-page toggle (two-step cost confirm, honest restart-pending state) and an agent-triggered install path (code_setup action=install-zg); off by default, ~430MB is never downloaded without a human nod.
author: njuptlzf

scripts.check: npm run check:patch && npm run check:client && npm run check:plugin && npm run check:chain && npm run check:tokens
